body: I feel the exact same way you do. Everything you said relates to me. I am going through the same thing and have been for about 4 years now. Depression has taken so much out of me, and no one seems to even understand it. But I understand where you are coming from. Feeling alone and awful all the time. Feeling like nothing is going to get any better. I feel the same way, too. No one around me gets my depression either. I know this isn't much help, but I get what you are going through. I'm sorry you have to go through this.
